{{Quote|Let's try, anyway. Otherwise, we'll go to his private office in the Presidential Tower.|Adi Gallia about Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum|<ref name="CoD" />}}
The '''Presidential Tower''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] had a private office in the building. His friend, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], suggested that she and her companion [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] go there instead to meet him.<ref name="CoD" />
